sentences.text:
This is repeat second bail application filed under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (in short "B.N.S.S."), for grant of bail to the applicant/accused, relating to FIR/Crime No.17/2024 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station-Lalghati, District- Shajapur (M.P.)
for the commission of offence punishable under sections 366, 376, 376 (2)(n) & 506 of the IPC.
After arguing at length, learned counsel for the applicant seeks leave of this Court to withdraw the bail application.
The other side has no objection.
M.Cr.C. is dismissed as withdrawn, accordingly.
